heroHeadline: Day 963: IDF Kills Mohammed Odeh — Fourth Hamas Military Chief Eliminated in 2026; Second Al-Qassam Commander Killed in 11 Days; 35 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Accountability Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 27, 2026 (Day 963 / Ceasefire Day 230 / Eid al-Adha): IDF killed Mohammed Odeh — Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades commander and October 7 planning architect — in an airstrike on the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City. Odeh was appointed May 18, 2026 to replace Izz al-Din al-Haddad (killed May 16), and was himself eliminated 9 days later. Six killed in the strike including Odeh's wife, two sons, and daughter. Netanyahu: 'Any one who harmed Israeli citizens — we will get to him.' Hamas confirmed his death. Odeh was Hamas military intelligence chief and Supreme Military Council member during October 7 planning — part of the NILI task force's systematic campaign targeting all ~3,000 participants. 35 days remain until the Israeli Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 accountability deadline. The Knesset coalition Kallner inquiry bill — stripped of 'independent investigation' language and barring judges — is heading to a first full Knesset plenum reading in the final days of May. The Beyachad alliance (Bennett-Lapid) pledges an independent state commission as Day 1 of any new government; 72% of Israelis (Hebrew University) favor an independent inquiry. Phase Two of the Gaza ceasefire remains in total deadlock. 857+ Palestinians killed since the October 10, 2025 ceasefire (Ceasefire Day 230). All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026.
